description: Chief Surefariate Southern Province - The Southern Provincial Council Sports Department has been Announced as a ''B'' Grade Department.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the reclassification of the Southern Provincial Council Sports Department from its previous incorporation to a 'B' Grade Department. The content describes an administrative/structural change to a government department (a provincial council department) without naming any specific individuals or detailing any personnel appointments. It fits the definition of an Organisational Gazette as it involves government structural changes with no people named.
